purpose: Targeted post-171 acquisition wave. Only net-new injection-moulding evidence families are staged; known overlaps are excluded. No third-party raw payload is committed and canonical measured counts remain unchanged until rights, retrieval, semantic, fingerprint, independence and profiling gates pass.

sources.name: LPBF conformal-cooling mould physical-part quality supplementary dataset
sources.value: Net-new physical quality evidence tying cooling-tool architecture to cycle time, dimensional accuracy, microstructure and mechanical properties on injection-moulded PP parts. It strengthens cooling/tooling validation but is not longitudinal fouling-cleaning-recovery evidence.

rights.supplementState: publisher-linked supplementary route; exact Zenodo file-level licence/fingerprint must be recorded before raw admission

sources.nextAction: Retrieve the exact supplementary payload through an approved binary route, record dataset-level licence, immutable hashes, file inventory, measured-vs-derived fields, sample/replicate identity and units, then profile before canonical admission.

sources.name: GNP-enhanced HDPE injection-process to mechanical-property raw dataset

reportedInputRanges.GNP_fraction: 0 to 0.05 in the published experiment table
reportedInputRanges.injectionTemperature_C: 170 to 210 in the published experiment table
reportedInputRanges.injectionPressure_MPa: approximately 20 to 38.4 in the published experiment table

sources.derivedDataBoundary: High/medium/low response classes and machine-learning predictions are derived; they must not be counted as additional physical measurements.
sources.value: Adds rights-clear measured process-to-mechanical-property evidence for HDPE composite moulding and extends material/process coverage beyond PP-heavy process datasets.
sources.nextAction: Retrieve exact Mendeley files, hash and profile rows/columns/missingness/units; separate raw measured tables from SEM images, analysed tables, code, derived classes and model outputs before admission.

sources.name: In-cavity pressure failure-diagnosis experiment for burn marks and short shots
sources.value: Independent physical defect/pressure evidence for diagnosing filling and switchover failures. This improves mechanism triangulation but does not provide a rights-cleared chronological shot-action-recovery raw corpus.
sources.nextAction: Search author/institution repositories or request the original pressure traces and cycle-condition table under explicit reuse terms; retain only publisher-verifiable aggregate mechanism evidence until then.
